question: When an arm of an angle is extended to double its length, then the measure of the angle:
solution:
**Given:**

When an arm of an angle is extended to double its length

**Formula used:**

The measure of an angle is independent of the length of its arms.

**Calculation:**

Extending the arm of the angle does not affect the angle itself.

⇒ The measure of the angle remains the same.

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
